_note: Config for scripts/metaqa_gold_path_check.py on the legacy v1 set (first 100 lines of each MetaQA vanilla test file): does the KG built by scripts/kg.py reproduce MetaQA's gold answer sets along some relation path from an entity named in the question? A substitute for executing official qa_*_qtype.txt gold paths, which are not available. The legacy question files carry no topic brackets, so topics_template_key is null and every KB entity mentioned is tried. min_entity_len skips one-character KB strings (e.g. '4') when matching mentions.
